versions.changelog:
Initial release of chart-generator-zc – a data visualization tool producing SVG and ASCII charts.

- Generates bar, line, pie, table, sparkline, gauge, dashboard, heatmap, and progress visualizations from the command line
- Supports both terminal-friendly ASCII output and standalone SVG/HTML files
- Minimal dependencies and instant chart generation via a single script
- Detailed usage instructions and flexible input data formats documented in SKILL.md
- Sample usage and output examples provided
